local.folder: Super Pixel Effects Gigapack (Free Version) v2.7.0

summary: Super Pixel Effects Gigapack (Free Version) v2.7.0 by unknown author: 5,512 files (8.6 MB) — 5,325 images (5,120 pixel-art, mostly 33-64 px, 182 animation sequences), 187 docs/licenses.

content.description: A large pixel-art VFX library (5,325 PNG frames and sheets, 16-512 px): fireballs, crescents, explosions, lightning strikes, smoke, sparks, elemental bursts, aura rings, beam strips and impact flashes, plus arcade-style UI symbols such as "BONUS!", X marks, numbers, a thumbs-up, letters and a 死 kanji. Bright saturated colours over black; many effects come as horizontal strips or frame folders per colour variant. Use for spells, hits, pickups, damage numbers and HUD feedback in 2D action games.
